missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Картошка' is feminine and stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Молодая' and 'вкусная' are the agreeing feminine adjectives. A clean descriptive card.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Картошку' is the feminine accusative as the object of 'люблю'. 'Жареную' agrees in the feminine accusative. A very common way to state a food preference.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Картошки' is the genitive after 'нет', marking what is missing. 'Свежей' is the agreeing feminine genitive adjective. A core shopping negation.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Картошкой' is the instrumental after 'с', meaning soup with potato. A common recipe construction for listing ingredients.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Картошке' is the dative after 'к', the thing to which butter is added. 'Немного масла' is the genitive quantity. Practical cooking language.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Картошке' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic of conversation. The impersonal 'можно' frames the sentence lightly.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a unit of measure. 'Картошки' is the genitive expressing the substance measured by 'два килограмма'. The imperative makes this a practical shopping phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Картошку' is the accusative object of 'продают'. 'Свежую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'на рынке' sets the location. Everyday market language.

missions.phrase: В подвале лежат мешки с картошкой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с' in a plural frame. 'Картошкой' is the instrumental after 'с', describing sacks of potato. 'Мешки' is the nominative plural subject. Useful storage vocabulary.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Картошка' is nominative as the subject of 'испортилась', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Эта' points at it and 'уже' adds time. A useful complaint pattern.
